purpose: Repeat the real Safari canvas discovery with an OCR-hardened test-owned canvas fixture while preserving exact-text-single-match semantics. The prior s01 failed because the PoC oracle misread a successful UNRESOLVED result as a found postcondition; s02 corrected that oracle and then showed that the original numeric/monospace canvas target was not exactly resolved by local Vision. s03 changes only the PoC fixture presentation and adds non-sensitive resolution diagnostics; product runtime remains unchanged.
requiredClaims: If Safari is already running, session execution is blocked before immutable evidence is created so user browser state is protected.
The discovery uses the existing product Safari application Provider and real Safari process/bundle identity.
The tested page is served only from loopback and requires no external network service.
The target and postcondition are rendered only into an HTML canvas with no accessible fallback text.
The s03 canvas uses alphabetic-only, large, high-contrast text solely to improve OCR observability; P3A exact-text-single-match policy is unchanged.
After the canvas target is exactly visually resolved, a fresh Safari Computer Control snapshot does not resolve that target semantically and produces structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
The real product macOS Vision text-region provider is selected locally through P5D.
The initial visual observation resolves exactly one target and explicitly reports the deterministic postcondition as VISUAL_TARGET_UNRESOLVED / NO_EXACT_TEXT_MATCH / matchCount=0.
The visual action is authorized only through the existing explicit primary-display left-click policy.
Real Computer Control delivery returns canonical CLICK_POSTED with semanticConsequenceVerified=false.
A fresh independent post-action visual observation must see exactly the deterministic postcondition and no longer see the original target before VERIFIED_SUCCESS is accepted.
No built-in Safari visual fallback contract exists during this discovery and none is created by the session.

If exact pre-action target resolution still fails, evidence may log only resolution state, semantic-target state, reason, match count, attempt count and total observation count; OCR text payloads remain unlogged.
Screenshot bytes, OCR payload text and coordinates are not persisted or printed to evidence.
Pointer, Safari process, loopback server, perception cache/runtime and temporary resources are cleaned up; Computer Use and Computer Control trees remain clean.
nonClaims: P6B does not validate a generic Safari visual fallback policy.
P6B does not ship or enable a built-in Safari registry contract.
P6B does not claim that arbitrary web canvas content is safe to click.
P6B does not introduce fuzzy, normalized or approximate matching into P3A.
P6B does not broaden action types, display topology or provider capabilities.
P6B does not rerun historical P1-P4 physical sessions or rewrite P5/P6A evidence.
P6B does not claim external-network browser automation or general browser competence.

s01.cause: PoC oracle treated resolveExactTextTarget ok=true / VISUAL_TARGET_UNRESOLVED as if the postcondition had already been found.

s02.cause: With the oracle corrected, local Vision did not exactly resolve the original RUMIAI CLICK 641 numeric/monospace canvas target before any semantic/action boundary was reached.

evidencePolicy.safariUserState: Preflight blocks before session creation when Safari is already running. The physical test repeats the guard for races.
evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s03 unchanged, use only the non-sensitive resolution diagnostics to classify the exact discovery boundary, fix forward only and create s04 only when justified.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned page content is used. Screenshot bytes, OCR observation text payloads and coordinates remain ephemeral and are not logged.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P6C bounded registry integration/promotion only from evidence-backed caller knowledge
